Description:
Job Title: Senior Business Analyst- Assistant Director
Experience- 10 to 16
Location- Bangalore, Kochi

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst with experience implementing global projects and programs with a high level of competency in Talent systems.  The ideal candidate will play a key role in gathering complex requirements, designing integrated solutions, and contributing to the strategic use of Talent data to support business objectives.

Your key responsibilities:
Requirement Gathering: Lead the gathering of complex business requirements from stakeholders, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of needs related to Talent systems, with a focus on SAP SuccessFactors and data integration
Process Engineering/Optimization: Analyze existing Talent processes, identify areas for optimization, and recommend solutions that leverage SAP SuccessFactors and other technologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
Data Integration: Collaborate with data architecture team to enable the data integration strategy, working closely with the technical teams. Work seamlessly to achieve efficient data exchange between SAP SuccessFactors and other relevant systems, with a focus on data quality and accuracy
Solution Design: Collaborate with technical teams to design integrated solutions, translating business needs into technical requirements, data mapping, security (RBP), and system functionalities
Data Analysis: Perform advanced data analysis, identifying trends, patterns, and insights from Talent data, and presenting findings to support data-driven decision-making
Documentation: Create detailed requirement documents, process flows, use cases, data mapping documents, and other relevant documentation to guide project implementation
Stakeholder Management: Engage with business stakeholders, executive leadership, and project teams, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and delivery of project objectives
Quality Assurance: Implement and maintain best practices for data quality, testing, and validation to ensure that SAP SuccessFactors and integrated systems meet business needs and quality standards
Change Management: Drive change management efforts to support end-users in adapting to new systems and processes resulting from SAP SuccessFactors implementations
Continuous Improvement: Proactively seek opportunities for process improvement, recommend enhancements to business processes and system functionalities

Skills and attributes for success
In-depth knowledge of Talent processes, system functionalities, data integration methodologies, and best practices
Proficiency in data analysis and tools, database query languages (e.g., SQL), and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI)
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights
Excellent documentation and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Strong project management capabilities, including the ability to lead and manage cross-functional teams
Positive attitude, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
Results-oriented, with a focus on achieving project objectives and driving positive outcomes
Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills
Ability to work virtually with global teams

To qualify for this role
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; additional certifications in business analysis or SAP SuccessFactors preferred
Proven experience as a Senior Business Analyst with a focus on Talent systems, SAP SuccessFactors, and data integration
As a Senior Business Analyst, 8 to 10 years of industry experience preferably in Talent

Job Summary
Results-driven CPQ Pricing Analyst with 2-3 years of hands-on experience implementing and optimizing CPQ solutions across mid-size to enterprise organizations. Skilled in platforms such as PROS CPQ with a strong focus on pricing strategy, product configuration, discounting rules, and quote-to-cash automation. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams-sales, finance, product, and IT-to gather business requirements, design scalable solutions, and deliver accurate, efficient quoting processes.
Roles & Responsibilities:
Provide functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools solutions like PriceFx, CONGA, PROS , SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus

Work on B2B Pricing Analytics (Exploratory Analysis & Reporting), target state analytics recommendation

Work as an integral part of the client-s sales organization, towards driving efficient and effective structure pricing and discounting approach.
You will work closely with our clients as Consulting Professionals who design, build, and implement strategies that can help enhance business performance within the Pricing & CPQ area.
The candidate will be responsible for providing functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools

Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills:
2-3 years of progressive industry and/or consulting experience in the Products/ Communications & High Tech/ Financial Services industry/ Resources
Experience working with PROS Smart Price Optimization & Management (POM) & Smart Configure Price Quote (CPQ). Certification in these areas is an advantage.
Functional experience in Pricing of Services, products, parts, and post sales services
Proficiency in MS Excel, Macro, and PowerPoint and exposure to Visualization Tools such as Power BI and Tableau
Knowledge of other Pricing & CPQ tools like PriceFx, CONGA, SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, PROS, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus are a plus

Additional Information
Nice to have certification in any one of the following or equivalent from other pricing/CPQ solutions
PROS Smart Price Optimization and Management
PROS Smart Configure Price Quote

Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.

Educational Qualifications

1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred
Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities
Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills

Role Purpose
The Customer Service Officer (Internship Trainee) will be responsible for managing customer service operations for unsecured lending products while undergoing structured rotational training across service desk, complaint management, regulatory grievance handling, and quality functions.
The role is designed to build a strong compliance-oriented, customer-centric operations leader for future managerial responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities
1. Service Desk Operations
Handle inbound customer interactions related to loan applications, disbursement, EMI servicing, foreclosure, and account queries
Ensure high First Call Resolution (FCR) and adherence to defined Turnaround Time (TAT)
Maintain accurate call documentation in CRM/system
Deliver consistent customer experience aligned with company standards
Register and track customer complaints in the system
Maintain proper documentation for audit and inspection purposes
2. Regulatory & Compliance Adherence
Strict adherence to RBI guidelines and internal policies
Ensure zero tolerance toward mis-leading information or incorrect commitments
Maintain audit-ready documentation of customer communication
Escalate sensitive cases to Nodal / Grievance Officer as per defined escalation matrix
3. Customer Experience & Process Improvement
Identify recurring service gaps and suggest corrective actions
Support implementation of process improvement initiatives
Contribute to service quality enhancement programs

Training & Rotational Exposure (1218 Months)
The InternshipTrainee will undergo structured exposure to:
Service Desk Operations
Welcome Calling
Complaint Desk & Escalation Handling
Regulatory Grievance Management
Quality & Training Function
MIS & Process Governance
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
First Call Resolution (FCR)
Average Handling Time (AHT)
Complaint TAT Compliance
Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
Audit & Compliance Score
Zero Regulatory Deviations
Qualification
Graduate (MBA in Finance / Operations / Marketing preferred)
02 years of relevant experience (Fresh MBA candidates may apply)
Skills & Competencies
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Analytical and problem-solving ability
Customer-centric approach
Compliance-driven mindset
Ability to handle pressure and escalations professionally
Working knowledge of CRM systems

Job Title: RA- Credit Life Reporting To- Manager - Credit Life
Location :
Will be responsible for managing a leading bank Loan Verticals and branches. Purpose of the Job (overall high level summary of the job)
Managing the Group credit life business, across locations and to achieve business volume (premium) and desired penetration. Regularly engage and provide market update, training & drive the ASCs (Loan Centre) to implement the set processes and ensuring seamless functioning of Grp Cr Life product within ASCs. He/she will be closely working with the Retail Asset Teams of the Bank to sell Group credit life Scheme along with the bank s primary product. He/she would plan, monitor, coach, communicate and execute sales strategies and gain mind share of the bank officials (at all levels) and then provide feedback. He/she will also in turn work with the Group Operations to follow up on issuance and clearing of pendency, if any.
Principal Accountabilities How they are achieved/measured
Manage the Group business with the Bank employees
Liaison with different departments for closure of the cases
Champion product and process to drive top line sales through business sales team and maintaining penetration levels of group insurance products with channel partner.
Coordinate and train key officials (ASSL, DSA, other bank officials) to enhance their understanding of the business to increase seller activisation
Provide market feedback on competition and other products in the market.
Manage and strengthen relationship through engagement with Partner s Zonal Leadership team, Ops & Credit Team, DSAs, SMs, Field Sales Staff at all levels and across functions. Values add in key initiatives to enhance attachment ration & business volume through training and service.
Tracking penetration performance and publishing dashboards, along with Group Operations.
To measure & monitor the various metrics (Files and sum assured Penetration rates, seller activation, Claim denial rates/ pending rates, rejection ratios , medical TATs etc), to minimize the same and adhere to TATs and contribute to product improvement.
Monitoring and control process of Post Sales.
Managing complete claims operation & end to end process.

Job Title: Relationship Manager
Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bangalore
Position Type : Fulltime
Work Mode : Work from Office

Employee Value Proposition:
Employee health insurance of Rs 1 lakh per year. Premium is paid by the company.
Employees get free lunch and snacks.
Monthly reward and recognition to outstanding performers.
Employees get promotions every 6 months based on performance.
Outstanding performers can qualify for promotion every quarter. So an employee can get promoted up to 4 times in a year. Every promotion results in a change of designation and increase of salary .
Accelerated career growth of employees and one can become UH in another 3 months time)
Regular team parties and Annual Day outing for all employees.

Qualication / Education and other Requirements:
Education- Any Undergraduate (BBA,B.Tech, B,A) etc.
Excellent verbal and written communication.
Good Interpersonal skills, numerical and analytical ability.
Decision making skills.
Language required: English & Hindi or English, Hindi & 1 South Regional Language (Kan, Tel, Tam)
Procient in MS-Office (Excel, Word).
Should be exible for day shift- (9-hour of login between 8 AM - 10 PM).
Comfortable with working 6 days a week and the week off will be on weekdays.

About the company
NoBroker.com is the world's largest C2C marketplace in online real estate. With a cumulative 85 lakh customers, it has grown 10X in the last one year. With three rounds of funding of $151 mn, it is well funded by key US, Indian, Japanese & Korean investors like General Atlantic,Tiger Global SAIF Partners, KTB ventures and BeeNext. It is headquartered in Bangalore with a team of 4000+ employees.

Role and Responsibility Relationship Manager
Act as relationship manager for the Paid customers of NoBroker.
Build sustainable relationships and trust with customer accounts through open and interactive communication.
Identify and assess customers' needs to effectively upsell or cross-sell relevant products or services.
Service customer in nding the right tenant / house as per the requirement of the customer.
Dial outbound and attend inbound calls of customers and leads.
Use internal tools and methods to provide the best possible service to the customer.
Negotiate with leads on behalf of customers.
Keep customers up-to-date on the progress of his account.
Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
Go extra mile to provide excellent customer service

About Training- Training will be provided for initial few days for an employee to understand the end to end process.
AboutCompany:
NoBroker is a leading Indian proptech company founded in 2013 by IIT and IIM alumni. It operates a consumer-to-consumer (C2C) real estate marketplace that connects property owners directly with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for brokers and middlemen. This model aims to reduce brokerage fees and create a transparent, seamless property transaction experience. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker is among India's pioneering platforms in the real estate space and has grown rapidly to become a unicorn, securing over $361 million in funding from investors such as Tiger Global, General Atlantic, and Google. Its services span major Indian cities including Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Pune, and Hyderabad.
NoBroker provides a comprehensive suite of services beyond property listings, including rental agreements, home loans, packers and movers, home services, property management, and society management through its app NoBrokerHood. The platform boasts over 75 lakh properties registered and facilitates more than 5,00,000 annual transactions.
The company places strong emphasis on innovation, customer-centric solutions, and data-driven technology to disrupt traditional real estate processes. NoBrokers culture promotes growth, meritocracy, and problem-solving, making it a desirable workplace in India's tech ecosystem.

Comfortable working 6 days a week with a weekday off.

Health insurance of Rs 1 lakh per year, with the premium covered by the company.
Monthly rewards and recognition for top performers.
Promotions every year based on performance.

Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis.
Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk.
Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process.
Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the ficial performance of the department.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
- Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.
- Understands the impact of department s operations on the overall property ficial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.
Supporting Management of Front Desk Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Sets a positive example for guest relations.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
- Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.
Managing Projects and Policies
- Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
- Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.
- Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.

- Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.
- Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
- Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.

- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.

- Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.

7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

In-depth experience with website analytics tools such as Google Analytics
Solid understanding of performance marketing, conversion, and online customer acquisition
Expertise in keyword research, data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of ranking factors and search engine algorithms
Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and SEM
Strong business acumen and expert communicator
Experience with A/B and multivariate experiments
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, and web development and industry-leading commerce tools

Bachelors/Masters in Marketing, Quantitative, Media or a related field

Optimize existing Magento 2 installation
Provide regular and emergency support for break-fixes
Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard
Anticipate the performance requirements and communicate with management on remediation plans to CTO/CIO
Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.

Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data
Develop integrations for files, images, etc.
Manage stack components and upgrade them (Ubuntu, PHP, Percona, Nginx, Composer, Firewall, Redis, etc.)
Create plans for developing mobile experience, mobile apps or PWA front end environment
Maintain confidentiality about IP, methods, processes and data
Participate in conferences, webinars and provide presentations while socializing and partnering with startups
Install security patches and monitor web traffic
brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends
Experience or knowledge of React.js, Vue.js and Node.js
Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
Magento 2 Certification is required
Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.

Must-Have Skills

Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytms B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytms PA PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. Indias largest digital lending story is brewing here. Its your opportunity to be a part of the story!

About this opportunity:

The position ensures orders are processed accurately, compliantly and within agreed service levels, while maintaining reliable status visibility, proactive risk escalation and effective coordination across customer, project and supply-chain stakeholders.
What you will do:
Customer purchase order validation and order creation.
Open-order management and fulfillment assurance.
Shipment, transit and delivery follow-up.
NEXT card aging and data quality.
Operational governance, meetings and escalation
The skills you bring:
Minimum 3 years of directly relevant experience in customer order management, order fulfillment or delivery operations, preferably supporting telecom, IT infrastructure, hardware deployment or complex B2B projects.
Proven ability to independently manage orders end to end, balance multiple priorities, lead stakeholder calls and resolve execution issues with limited supervision.
Working understanding of procurement, supply-chain operations, logistics, shipping milestones, vendor coordination and installation/deployment handover.
Practical experience with ERP/order-management platforms, including SAP and/or NEXT or comparable systems; familiarity with intercompany ordering and PO-to-delivery controls.
Strong Excel capability, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, PivotTables, filters, data reconciliation and operational tracker management.

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We have an exciting opportunity at our company Tata Business Hub for a Lead Sourcing Role, and based on your experience and skill set, we believe this role could be a great fit for you.

Company Details : Tata Business Hub is a digital first B2B organization setup by TATA Group to holistically address the needs of Emerging Businesses. We value the pivotal role of emerging businesses in our Nations economic growth and prosperity, and believe in empowering them to be deeply aware, widely connected and digitally integrated. Offering a host of economical and highly relevant business capabilities, Tata Business Hub aims to be the catalyst, propelling emerging businesses into new frontiers of growth and performance.

At Tata Business Hub, our ambition is vast-

We want to become the pre-eminent company that works for MSMEs in India
Grow their business
Solve their challenges
Optimize their processes

Lead implementation and execution of procurement processes with existing and new vendors/ partners
Develop detailed sourcing strategy and category plans to maximize effectiveness and efficiency
Embrace change, utilize and champion new & existing digital tools and portals applicable to the role.
Build and maintain strong relationships with local suppliers to ensure reliable and consistent steel supply.
Lead negotiations to achieve the best possible pricing, payment terms, and cost efficiencies through volume aggregation and strategic partnerships.
Ensure that all procured steel products meet the company's quality standards and comply with industry regulations.
Continuously monitor steel market trends, price fluctuations, and emerging risks to inform procurement strategies and make informed purchasing decisions.
Conducting supplier reliability assessment, developing KPIs, joint action plan and providing feedback to identify areas of improvement
Identify potential supply chain risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure continuous steel supply and business continuity.
Continuously assess and improve procurement processes to enhance efficiency, reduce lead times, and drive cost savings.
Provide updates about procurement related progress and potential delays on a daily basis to the Sourcing/ Category Lead
Exposure of MSME universe preferably in the Raw Material procurement sector.
Maintain an awareness of pricing and industry market conditions. Provide pricing and product availability to all customers basis the guideline and processes outlined.
Strong team player and comfortable with new categories and customer profile.

Work experience:

Atleast 10 years of proven experience in purchase/ procurement in one or more industries/ market/ commodity segments such as EPC, Manufacturers, OEMs, Automotive, Building materials
Entrepreneurial and business owner mindset (startup experience a big plus) owning some big accounts themselves
Passion and energy to drive hyper growth in a new yet rapidly growing business segment
If you're a motivated individual with a keen eye for quality and a desire to drive excellence in every project, we invite you to apply and join our team.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Description:
Workday HCM & Payroll Consultant

Position: Workday HCM & Payroll Consultant
Experience: 7+ Years
Employment Type: Remote
Shift: UK Shift 9 Hours
Working Days: 5 Days a Week
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Only
Work Location: Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Trichy, Bangalore, Noida, Gurgaon – Remote
Interview Rounds: 2 Rounds

Job Description -

We are looking for an experienced Workday HCM & Payroll Consultant with 7+ years of experience to support and deliver Workday HCM and Payroll solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong functional knowledge of Workday HCM and Payroll, experience in configuration and implementation/support activities, and the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities
Implement, configure, and support Workday HCM and Payroll modules.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective Workday solutions.
Configure Workday business processes, workflows, security, and functional areas.
Support payroll-related processes, integrations, and issue resolution.
Perform impact analysis, testing, troubleshooting, and defect resolution.
Work with HR, Payroll, and business teams to understand requirements and provide solutions.
Participate in Workday enhancement, implementation, and production support activities.
Prepare functional documentation, test scenarios, and process documentation.
Support data validation, reconciliation, and payroll-related reporting activities.
Coordinate with technical and functional teams for integrations and issue resolution.
Ensure solutions comply with business and payroll requirements.

Required Skills & Experience-

7+ years of overall experience in Workday HCM and Payroll.
Strong hands-on experience as a Workday HCM & Payroll Consultant.
Good understanding of Workday HCM business processes.
Strong knowledge of Workday Payroll processes and configurations.
Experience in Workday configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and support.
Good understanding of Workday integrations and data flow.
Experience working with HR/Payroll stakeholders and business users.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work in a UK shift environment.

Must Have
Workday HCM
Workday Payroll
Workday Configuration
Workday Business Processes
Workday Support / Implementation
7+ Years of Experience
Immediate Joiner

Additional Information
Remote opportunity.
Candidates must be available for the UK shift (9 hours).
Immediate joiners only.
Laptop is mandatory for the interview.
Both Virtual and Face-to-Face interview rounds are mandatory.


Thanks,

Experience with EIB (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Hands-on experience with Core Connectors and Workday integration technologies.
Experience in Workday Report Writer, Advanced Reports, Calculated Fields, and dashboards.
Good understanding of Workday HCM data and business processes.
Experience with XML, XSLT, SOAP, REST APIs and web services.

General Manager Sales & Marketing (Engineering Polymers / Plastics)
You are responsible for leading the commercial, technical, and strategic growth for high-performance plastics and compounds.
Drive revenue, expand market share, manage P&L (Profit & Loss), and building B2B partnerships and oversee commodity polymer trends (PP, PE, PVC), negotiate high-volume contracts, manage strategic distributor relationships, and direct technical marketing for high-performance thermoplastics (e.g., Nylon, PEEK, Polycarbonates, customized polymer compounds) across target industrial segments.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic & Financial Leadership
F P&L Management: Own revenue targets, gross contribution margins, pricing strategies, and annual budgeting for engineering polymer lines.
F Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy: Formulate and execute regional or global business development plans to scale market presence.
F Market & Competitor Analysis: Track raw material pricing volatility (petrochemical trends), freight costs, and competitor benchmarks.
Business Development & Key Accounts
F OEM & Processor Relationships: Build direct relationships with major OEMs, tier-1/tier-2 suppliers, and injection moulders/converters.
F Product Substitution: Drive metal-to-plastic or standard-to-engineering polymer conversion initiatives.
F Channel Management: Establish, evaluate, and manage distributor and channel partner networks.
Commodity Market Analysis
F Monitor petrochemical pricing fluctuations, global supply chain bottlenecks, global commodity trends (PP, PE, PVC, PET), currency fluctuations, and competitor pricing to manage risk and optimize trading margins.
B2B Brand Management
F Build brand equity and trust among suppliers (refineries/producers), logistics providers, and industrial buyers.
Commercial Strategy & Trading
F Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for trading commodity and engineering polymers.
Technical & Cross-Functional Coordination
F Technical Sales Support: Collaborate with R&D, production, and quality assurance teams to define technical specifications (MFI, density, impact, tensile strength, fillers) and manage customer trials.
F Product Development: Guide sample testing, custom grade development, and compliance validation for client applications.
Team Management
F Leadership & Mentoring: Direct, coach, and evaluate regional sales managers, technical application engineers, and account executives.
F Performance Tracking: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) including sales volume in metric tons, customer acquisition rates, and collection cycles.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
Revenue Growth: Target achievement in sales volume and overall market share.
Profitability: Margin optimization against global commodity volatility.
Supplier & Client Acquisition: Diversity of supplier networks and conversion of B2B key accounts.
Risk-adjusted Return on Capital (RAROC): Management of credit cycles, inventory holding, and trade logistics.
Gross profit margins on plastic raw materials and compounding resins.
Sales volume (in Metric Tons) vs. quarterly/annual forecasts.
Customer acquisition rates and retention in key end-use verticals.
Inventory turnover and logistical cost optimization

Preferred candidate profile
1. Bachelor of Engineering in Polymer or Plastics Chemical or related Engineering Field is a must with MBA in Marketing is strongly preferred with 12 to 20+ years of progressive commercial and sales leadership experience specifically within engineering plastics, polymer compounding, or chemical raw materials.
2. Strong grasp of polymer rheology, resin properties, application engineering, and ERP/CRM tools (e.g., SAP, Salesforce).
3. B2B contract negotiation, high-volume account management, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven forecasting
4. Proficiency in data-driven decision-making, supply-demand forecasting, and CRM utilization.
5. Ability to communicate complex market intelligence to C-suite executives and board members.
6. Decisive leadership when navigating volatile commodity markets or supply chain crises.

Description:
Oracle Fusion HCM UK Payroll & Fast Formula Consultant

Employment Type: Permanent
Experience: 5-8 Years
Positions: 1
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Only
Work Location: Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Trichy, Bangalore, Noida, Gurgaon
Work Mode: Hybrid
Laptop: Mandatory for Interview
Interview Rounds: 2 Rounds

Job Summary-

We are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion HCM UK Payroll & Fast Formula Functional Consultant with strong expertise in Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM UK Payroll and Fast Formula.
The consultant will be responsible for implementing, configuring, testing, supporting, and enhancing UK Payroll solutions, including payroll elements, balances, statutory calculations, legislative updates, and Fast Formula-based business rules.

Key Responsibilities-

Implement and configure Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM UK Payroll solutions.
Configure UK Payroll elements, balances, payroll definitions, statutory deductions, and legislative rules.
Develop and optimize Fast Formulas for payroll calculations, validations, absence, Time & Labor, and other HCM requirements.
Gather requirements, perform solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-production support.
Handle UK payroll legislative updates, HMRC requirements, and statutory changes.
Troubleshoot payroll calculation issues and debug Fast Formulas.
Conduct system testing, integration testing, and UAT.
Support payroll runs, reconciliation, issue resolution, and post-payroll activities.
Work with technical teams on integrations between Oracle HCM and third-party systems such as Finance, HR, Time & Attendance, and Benefits.
Prepare functional design documents, configuration workbooks, test scripts, and user guides.
Interact with UK-based stakeholders and payroll teams in an onshore-offshore delivery model.
Support end users and provide guidance on Oracle Fusion UK Payroll best practices.

Must-Have Skills

58 years of experience in Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud.
Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion UK Payroll Functional.
Strong expertise in Oracle Fusion Fast Formula.
Experience with UK Payroll elements, balances, payroll definitions, statutory calculations, and legislative updates.
Strong understanding of UK Payroll legislation and HMRC requirements.
Experience in at least one end-to-end UK Payroll implementation or major enhancement project.
Good understanding of Oracle HCM Cloud data model, security, and payroll-related reporting.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.
Good stakeholder management and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively with global teams.

Good to Have
Oracle HCM Cloud certification in UK Payroll and/or Fast Formula.
Experience with Oracle HCM integrations.
Experience working with UK-based clients/stakeholders.
Strong documentation and presentation skills.
Experience in payroll controls, reconciliation, audit readiness, and data accuracy.

Education
Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, HR, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Important
Only Immediate Joiners are preferred.

Executive / Asst. Manager - Direct Tax
To support the Direct Tax function in managing tax compliance, litigation, assessments and tax advisory matters, while ensuring timely execution, effective risk management appropriate tax governance across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
1. Direct Tax Compliance
F Manage and review regular direct tax compliances including advance tax, incme-tax return, TDS/TCS and related filings.

F Review tax positions arising from business transactions and ensure appropriate tax treatment.
F Monitor changes in the Income-tax Act, rules, circulars and judicial developments and assess their impact on the Company.
2. Tax Litigation & Assessments
F Handle ongoing income-tax assessments, appeals and other tax proceedings in coordination with external tax advisors.
F Prepare factual submissions, tax positions and supporting documentation for tax authorities.
F Maintain litigation trackers, monitor timelines and ensure timely responses to notices.
F Assist in developing litigation strategy and identifying key tax risks and opportunities.
3. Tax Advisory / Business Support
F Provide tax inputs on business transactions, contracts, investments, capital expenditure and other commercial matters.
F Analyse tax implications of proposed transactions and support business teams in making tax-efficient and compliant decisions.
F Assist in evaluating tax implications of new projects, expansion/capex and business restructuring.
F Coordinate with Legal, Secretarial, Finance, Commercial, Treasury and other stakeholders on tax matters.
4. Tax Accounting & Reporting
F Support computation and review of current tax and deferred tax in coordination with Finance/Accounts and auditors.
F Assist in preparation of tax provisions, tax reconciliations and tax-related disclosures.
F Support statutory and internal audit requirements relating to direct tax.
5. Tax Governance & Process Improvement
F Identify opportunities to strengthen tax processes, controls and documentation.
F Drive reconciliation and automation initiatives in direct tax compliance and reporting.
F Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails for key tax positions.
F Assist in developing SOPs and tax governance frameworks.
6. Transfer Pricing / International Tax
F Support transfer pricing compliance, including documentation, benchmarking and filings.
F Assist in reviewing cross-border transactions and international tax implications.
F Coordinate with external advisors on transfer pricing and other international tax matters.

2. Strong working knowledge of Income-tax Act, TDS/TCS and tax litigation.
3. Experience in handling assessments, notices and tax authority correspondence.
4. Good understanding of tax accounting, deferred tax and basic Ind AS 12 concepts.
5. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
6. Ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.
7. Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
8. Strong Excel and tax-research skills
9. Exposure to tax technology/automation.

Lead solution design and implementation aspects of the engagement by ensuring high quality within time and budget constraints
Plan and develop integration and separation deliverables, including Day One readiness and execution, business process and systems integration and separation
Develop financial models for IT, including synergy savings, one-time costs, standalone costs and stranded costs
Recommend enterprise architecture, solutions, and systems based on industry leading practices and past experiences

- Conducting performance assessments and developing performance management strategies
- Implementing cost management and profitability management techniques to improve financial outcomes

- Providing coaching and feedback to team members to foster professional growth and development

Job Summary
We are seeking experienced Data Privacy professionals to join our expanding practice. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of global privacy regulations, hands-on experience with privacy operations, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams. Candidates with strong communication, problem-solving skills, and stakeholder management capabilities are encouraged to apply.
The opportunity : Consultant/Senior Consultant - Tech Consulting - TMT - CNS - TC - Data Privacy - New Delhi
Data Privacy Professional Location Bangalore
Experience 2-8 years depending on role


About the Role

Responsibilities
Conduct privacy gap assessments for business processes/applications against global data protection regulations and standard including DPDPA, GDPR, CPRA and ISO 27701.
Draft data privacy policies, procedures, guidelines, and SOPs.
Determine and support execution of Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA).
Draft Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), develop Personal Data Inventories (PDI), and create Data Flow Diagrams (DFD).
Develop and deliver privacy training and awareness programs.
Privacy Engineering Architecture: Deep understanding of privacy concepts, Privacy by Design principles, and implementation in real-world processes.
Experience with Privacy Management Tools (PMT) and Privacy Enhancing Technologies (PET).
Expertise in tools such as OneTrust, BigID, and Securiti.ai.
Ability to drive overall privacy compliance architecture for clients.


Must-Have Skills
Strong understanding of global privacy regulations (GDPR, CPRA, DPDPA, etc.).
Experience in privacy risk assessments, RoPA, DFD, DPIA, and documentation.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.


Good-to-Have (Preferred)
Certifications: CIPP/E, CIPM, ISO 27001, ISO 27701.
Experience with privacy tech platforms like OneTrust, BigID, and Securiti.ai.
Familiarity with ISO 27701 and NIST Privacy Framework.
Industry experience in Consumer Goods, Automotive, eCommerce, etc.

Description:
Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Pune

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.

Brief about the Team & Fractal
Fractal partners with Fortune 500 organizations to unlock business value through AI, Data, Cloud, and Digital Transformation. We combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, generative AI, and cloud technologies to help clients accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and drive measurable business outcomes. As organizations increasingly adopt cloud-first strategies, AWS plays a critical role in enabling scalable, secure, and data-driven transformation journeys.

Role Summary:
The Client Partner - Head of AWS is responsible for driving AWS-led business growth, expanding strategic client relationships, owning practice P&L, and delivering large-scale cloud transformation programs. This leader will serve as the executive sponsor for key client engagements, strengthen Fractals partnership with AWS, and help clients leverage AWS services to accelerate AI, Analytics, Data, and Digital modernization initiatives.
The role requires a blend of executive client engagement, cloud consulting expertise, sales leadership, alliance management, and business operations to scale the AWS practice.
Roles & Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership
Define and execute the growth strategy for Fractals AWS Practice, aligned with the organizations overall business objectives.
Own the AWS Practice P&L, including revenue growth, margins, utilization, and overall business performance.
Develop offerings, accelerators, solution assets, and industry-specific cloud transformation propositions.
Collaborate with leadership teams to identify emerging market opportunities and expand AWS-led services.
Client Partnership & Business Growth
Build and manage executive relationships with C-level stakeholders across strategic accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cloud transformation, modernization, AI/ML, data platform, and generative AI initiatives.
Drive account mining, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across existing and new clients.
Lead strategic pursuits and large transformation deals from opportunity identification through closure.
Develop account growth plans and oversee pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue realization.

AWS Alliance & Ecosystem Management
Serve as the primary leadership interface between Fractal and AWS.
Strengthen relationships with AWS sales, solution architecture, and partner teams.
Drive joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, AWS-funded programs, and marketplace engagements.
Ensure alignment with AWS partner competencies, specializations, and certifications.
Represent Fractal in AWS industry events, leadership forums, and customer engagements.
Practice & Talent Leadership
Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of AWS architects, consultants, engineers, and client partners.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Drive capability development across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Security, Modernization, and GenAI on AWS.
Establish career development frameworks and succession plans within the AWS practice.
Service Delivery Excellence
Oversee successful delivery of AWS transformation programs across clients and industries.
Ensure projects meet quality, timeline, security, compliance, and business outcome expectations.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to improve delivery methodologies, governance, and customer satisfaction.
Act as an executive escalation point for strategic accounts and critical programs.
Innovation & Thought Leadership
Stay current with AWS technologies, industry trends, and emerging cloud capabilities.
Lead development of cloud-native AI and data modernization solutions leveraging AWS services.
Contribute to thought leadership through client workshops, industry forums, conferences, and publications.
Promote innovation through reusable frameworks, automation accelerators, and solution assets.
Financial Leadership
Develop and manage annual business plans and growth targets for the AWS practice.
Drive profitable growth through effective resource planning and portfolio management.
Monitor key business metrics including revenue, margins, utilization, pipeline, and customer satisfaction.
Identify opportunities for operational efficiency and cost optimization.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. MBA preferred.
18+ years of experience in technology consulting, cloud services, digital transformation, or managed services.
Proven experience leading large AWS practices, cloud consulting organizations, or strategic cloud businesses.
Demonstrated track record of managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios and driving profitable growth.
Strong understanding of AWS Cloud services, Data Platforms, AI/ML, GenAI, Security, DevOps, Modernization, and Migration services.
Experience managing executive client relationships across Fortune 500 organizations.
Strong commercial acumen with expertise in deal shaping, negotiations, and contract management.
Proven ability to build and lead geographically distributed teams.

Impeccable team management skills with an ability to engage effectively with multiple stakeholders

Excellent communication, interpersonal and presentation skills
Cross-cultural competence with an ability to thrive in a dynamic environment

Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh (HIAL) is an upcoming Alternative Institute for Mountain Development which follows Contextual Learning and Experiential Pedagogy where students learn by doing and earn while they learn. It aims to develop Ladakh into a benchmark of sustainable living for the mountain world, where all children receive a meaningful education that prepares them for a life of dignity in harmony with nature. Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What Youll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a dynamic and target-driven Senior Manager SME Inside Sales to lead a large sales organization and drive revenue growth, customer retention, and account expansion. The role involves managing 2 Assistant Managers and 50–60 associates, building a high-performance culture, and delivering business targets through data-driven sales strategies and effective people leadership.

Key Responsibilities
* Own revenue, growth, retention, and productivity targets for the function.
* Lead and mentor 2 Assistant Managers and drive performance across 50–60 associates.
* Drive account growth through upselling, cross-selling, share-of-wallet gains, and increased order frequency.
* Improve customer retention, reduce churn, and strengthen long-term account relationships.
* Monitor sales funnel performance, conversion rates, revenue per associate, and key business KPIs.
* Drive forecasting, business reviews, performance management, and continuous process improvement.
* Collaborate with Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product teams to enhance customer experience and business outcomes.
* Leverage customer insights and analytics to identify growth opportunities and improve platform stickiness.
Requirements
* 7+ years of experience in Inside Sales, Key Account Management, Account Management, or Customer Retention.
* Proven experience managing large sales teams and delivering revenue and growth targets.
* Strong expertise in sales funnel management, customer retention, upselling, and cross-selling.
* Excellent leadership, analytical, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.

Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.

Overview:
We are seeking a motivated and experienced Senior Education Counsellor to guide students in their pursuit of education and careers in the hospitality sector. Key Responsibilities:

Student Counselling: Provide expert guidance to students regarding course selection and
career opportunities within the hospitality industry.
Walk-In Engagement: Attend to walk-in students and their parents, offering informative
consultations and addressing queries effectively.
Lead Conversion: Convert leads into confirmed admissions by implementing strategic follow-
up and persuasive communication.

regular follow-up sessions and doubt-clearing discussions to ensure clarity and confidence in
their educational choices.

students into confirmed admissions and tracking progress.
Coordination with Hotels: Collaborate with hospitality partners to monitor and support student
progress and internship placements.
Initiatives and Marketing: Actively participate in marketing activities and initiatives to enhance
enrolment and promote school and college campaigns and outreach campaigns.

Qualifications:
Bachelor degree in Education, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related
field.
Proven experience in student counselling, sales, or related fields, preferably in the education or
hospitality sector.

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. The opportunity: Executive-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities
Support consulting and advisory projects through research, data collection, analysis, and documentation.
Assist in preparing reports, presentations, concept notes, proposals, and other client deliverables.
Conduct secondary research, market assessments, policy reviews, and stakeholder mapping to support project objectives.
Analyze data and synthesize findings into clear and actionable insights.
Participate in client meetings, workshops, surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to support project execution.
Assist in monitoring project timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements.
Contribute to business development activities, including proposal preparation and knowledge management initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, government policies, and sector developments relevant to assigned projects.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to conduct research and interpret information from multiple sources.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Ability to work effectively in a team environment and manage multiple tasks.
Strong learning mindset, professional attitude, and willingness to take ownership of assignments.


Qualifications
"Bachelors or Masters degree in Management, Economics, Public Policy, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, Social Sciences, or a related discipline."


Experience
0-2 years Entry Level


What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
0–3 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role.
Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools
Prior experience in logistics, e-commerce, D2C, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.
Who Will Do Well in This Role?
Someone who is sharp, articulate, proactive, and comfortable speaking to customers every day—someone who enjoys sales and account management, takes ownership, learns quickly, and can turn customer conversations into meaningful business opportunities.
If you are looking to build a career in Inside Sales, Account Management & Customer Success with one of India’s leading logistics companies, we’d love to hear from you.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities
