About Livspace
Livspace is a leading home interiors and renovation platform that simplifies the home interiors journey for homeowners. We combine design, technology, and execution excellence to create beautiful, functional spaces.
Role Overview
As an Interior Designer at Livspace, you will own projects end-to-end, from the first client interaction to final closure. You will combine design expertise, customer empathy, and business ownership to deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve business goals.
Key Responsibilities
Translate customer requirements into functional and aesthetically appealing space plans.
Own and deliver complete interior design deliverables.
Provide an exceptional, trust-led customer experience.
Manage the project pipeline and achieve monthly revenue targets.
Ensure a smooth and seamless handover of projects to execution teams.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Minimum 2 years of experience in residential interiors, including modular interiors and space planning.
Bachelor’s degree in Interior Design, B.Arch, or equivalent qualification; alternatively, a 2–3 year diploma with 2+ years of residential interiors experience.
Proficiency in AutoCAD or similar design tools.
Experience in client-facing roles or design-and-build environments.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
High ownership mindset and comfort working in a target-driven environment.

Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a talented IBM DataStage Developer with 23 years of experience in ETL development, data integration, and data warehousing projects. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in IBM InfoSphere DataStage, SQL, and database technologies, with the ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL solutions that support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy ETL jobs using IBM InfoSphere DataStage.
Develop and maintain data integration workflows for loading data from multiple source systems into data warehouses and data marts.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical ETL solutions.
Implement data cleansing, validation, and transformation logic.
Optimize DataStage jobs for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support UAT activities.
Troubleshoot ETL job failures and resolve production issues.
Work closely with database administrators, business analysts, and data architects.
Maintain technical documentation and adhere to development standards.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with organizational policies.
Required Skills
2 - 8 years of hands-on experience in IBM InfoSphere DataStage development.
Strong experience in ETL design and development.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Knowledge of DataStage components including:
Designer
Director
Administrator
Manager
Parallel Jobs
Sequence Jobs
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Description:
About the role:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and technically strong Car Inspection Engineer to
conduct comprehensive inspections of used cars sourced through dealer partners. The role is
responsible for accurately assessing a vehicle’s mechanical condition, body condition,
structural integrity, and overall quality, while ensuring standardized inspection processes and
transparent reporting.

What You Will Do:
Conduct detailed physical inspections of used cars at dealer locations, customer locations, yards, and designated inspection centers. 
Assess key vehicle systems including engine, transmission, suspension, brakes, tyres, steering, electrical systems, AC, and other mechanical components. 
Inspect the exterior and interior condition of vehicles, including body panels, paint quality, dents, scratches, accidental repairs, and signs of structural damage. 
Identify critical vehicle issues such as flood damage, major accidents, odometer tampering, structural damage, and significant mechanical defects. 
Conduct road tests to evaluate vehicle performance, drivability, handling, braking, and overall condition. 
Verify VIN/chassis number, engine number, registration details, and other relevant vehicle documents. 
Use diagnostic tools, inspection equipment, mobile applications, and digital platforms to conduct standardized vehicle assessments. 
Prepare accurate and detailed inspection reports with photographs, observations, identified defects, and recommendations. 
Identify approximate refurbishment/repair costs and clearly highlight major repairs or quality concerns. 
Complete inspections and reports within defined Turnaround Time (TAT). 
Clearly communicate critical defects, major repairs, and vehicle quality concerns to internal teams and dealer stakeholders 
Follow defined inspection SOPs, checklists, quality standards, and safety protocols. 
Maintain accurate inspection records and ensure data quality on the inspection platform/mobile application. 
Identify recurring vehicle quality issues and provide actionable feedback to improve inspection processes, standards, and quality controls. 
What we are looking for:
ITI, Diploma, or Graduate qualification in Automobile Engineering. 
3–5 years of relevant experience as an Automobile Evaluator, Mechanic, Service Advisor, Assistant Service Advisor, or similar role. 
Experience working with passenger vehicles and strong understanding of automotive systems and components. 
Strong multi-brand vehicle technical knowledge. 
Ability to identify accidental damage, mechanical defects, structural issues, and major repair requirements. 
Hands-on experience with vehicle diagnostic tools and inspection applications will be preferred.
Strong attention to detail with excellent observation and problem-solving skills. 
Ability to prepare clear, accurate, and unbiased inspection reports. 
Comfortable using smartphones, tablets, and digital inspection platforms. 
Willingness to travel extensively for vehicle inspections. 
Valid driving licence and practical driving skills preferred. 
What we will give you:
Opportunity to work with modern digital inspection platforms, diagnostic tools, and technology-enabled processes. 
A fast-paced environment where your technical expertise directly influences vehicle quality and business decisions. 
A role with strong ownership, autonomy, and visibility in a growing automotive business. 
A performance-driven environment with opportunities for learning, growth, and career progression. 
At OLX India, we are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage people of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply.
We embrace diversity and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you are as excited as we are about this position and our company, we hope you join us! To learn more, take a look at our website.
"Our Success is fueled by diverse perspectives and talents."

Description:
ABOUT SAPCON STEELS PRIVATE LIMITED
At Sapcon, we don't just trade steel - we power the backbone of India's industrial growth. As one of the country's leading names in steel and industrial commodities, we've built our reputation on a simple promise: the right material, to the right customer, at the right time, every time.
With 35+ strategically located supply hubs across India and trusted partnerships with industry titans like JSPL, AMNS, SAIL and JSW, we sit at the intersection of scale and agility. From automotive plants and shipyards to solar farms, HVAC manufacturers, and the infrastructure shaping India's skylines, our steel moves industries forward.
Join us, and your work will directly fuel the projects transforming a nation.
Key responsibilities
Administer and configure the CRM: users, roles, permissions, profiles, fields, page layouts, and picklists
Build and maintain automations, including workflows, approval processes, assignment rules, and email templates
Own data quality: run regular de-duplication, imports and exports, validation rules, and data cleanup
Create and maintain reports and dashboards for sales pipeline, lead conversion, forecasting, and team performance
Reconcile CRM data with ERP and finance systems (orders, invoices, collections)
Research and build targeted lead lists by industry, region, company size, and product fit
Enrich leads with company data such as turnover, capacity, products, GST/registration details, and location
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, or a related field
2–4 years of hands-on experience administering a CRM such as Salesforce, Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Frappe CRM
Strong grasp of sales processes: lead to order cycle
Proficiency in Microsoft 365 especially Excel, including lookups, pivots, and data cleaning
Experience building reports and dashboards
Nice to have
CRM certification (e.g. Salesforce Certified Administrator, Zoho CRM Certified)
Basic knowledge of AI, SQL, APIs, or low-code automation tools (Zapier, Power Automate)
Detail-oriented, organised, and comfortable managing multiple requests

Description:
Job Summary
The opportunity: Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh
GOV: Our Global Government Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
SaT:
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sectors diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY's Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firms sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social Health care, Education, Urban Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste Sanitation, Power Utilities and Public Finance Management.
SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory :
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to todays toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
Minimum 5 years of experience in consulting, advisory, strategy, research, analytics, policy, or project management. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Experience in conducting research, stakeholder engagement, interviews, and quantitative and qualitative analysis. Excellent communication, report-writing, and presentation development skills. Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and manage diverse stakeholders. Strong client management and project coordination skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other analytical and reporting tools. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality outcomes. Experience in government advisory, public policy, economic development, institutional strengthening, or transformation projects will be an added advantage. Engage with clients to understand business challenges and deliver practical, evidence-based solutions. Support the planning, execution, and monitoring of consulting and advisory assignments across government, public sector, and private sector engagements. Conduct market assessments, policy research, stakeholder consultations, and data analysis to generate meaningful insights and recommendations. Prepare high-quality reports, presentations, strategy papers, business cases, and other client deliverables. Develop financial, operational, and impact assessments to support informed decision-making. Work closely with project teams, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Build and maintain strong client relationships while ensuring high standards of service and professionalism.
Skills and attributes
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
Any Post Graduation
Experience
5+ years of overall experience
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Job Summary
The opportunity : Senior Project Consultant-GOV-SaT-SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory - Chandigarh


GOV
Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.


SaT
The Government and public sector transactions services is part of EY's Government & Public Sector (GPS) Services which is a network of highly skilled professionals from assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, devoted to serving the government and public sector organizations and institutions.
The practice combines private sector leading practice with an understanding of the public sector s diverse needs, focused on delivering improved public services. Government and public sector transactions services, sits under EY s Transaction Advisory Services practice, a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team, working with leading businesses across a range of industries. This practice is in a unique position to deliver implementable strategies given the firm s sector depth, transaction perspectives, and operational insights.
The practice provides experience working with various sectors such as, Transport, Social & Health care, Education, Urban & Infrastructure, Economic Development Advisory , Water waste & Sanitation, Power & Utilities and Public Finance & Management.


SaT - TCF - Infrastructure Advisory
Strategy and Transactions enables clients to reimagine ecosystems, reshape portfolios and reinvent for a better future. Using our Capital Agenda framework, we work with clients to find answers to today s toughest strategic, financial, operational and commercial questions. We help corporates, private equity, governments, sovereign wealth funds, private and family businesses, and educational institutions with their key financial issues. From portfolio review and capital allocation processes to financial planning analytics and decision support, we have the people, analytics and tools to better allocate capital. Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.


Your key responsibilities

Technical Excellence
Minimum 5 years of experience in consulting, advisory, strategy, research, analytics, policy, or project management. Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Experience in conducting research, stakeholder engagement, interviews, and quantitative and qualitative analysis. Excellent communication, report-writing, and presentation development skills. Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and manage diverse stakeholders. Strong client management and project coordination skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other analytical and reporting tools. Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality outcomes. Experience in government advisory, public policy, economic development, institutional strengthening, or transformation projects will be an added advantage. Engage with clients to understand business challenges and deliver practical, evidence-based solutions. Support the planning, execution, and monitoring of consulting and advisory assignments across government, public sector, and private sector engagements. Conduct market assessments, policy research, stakeholder consultations, and data analysis to generate meaningful insights and recommendations. Prepare high-quality reports, presentations, strategy papers, business cases, and other client deliverables. Develop financial, operational, and impact assessments to support informed decision-making. Work closely with project teams, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery. Build and maintain strong client relationships while ensuring high standards of service and professionalism.


Skills and attributes

To qualify for the role you must have

Qualification
Any Post Graduation
Experience
5+ years of overall experience
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-oriented Admission Counselor to guide working professionals in choosing the right upGrad programs based on their career goals and professional experience.

Key Responsibilities
Connect with working professionals through calls and other communication channels to understand their career and learning requirements.
Counsel prospective learners about upGrad programs, courses, eligibility, and career benefits.
Follow up with leads and convert prospective learners into enrolled students.
Achieve assigned monthly admission and revenue targets.
Maintain regular follow-ups and build strong relationships with prospective learners.
Handle queries and objections related to programs, fees, eligibility, and career outcomes.
Maintain accurate lead and conversion records in the CRM.
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth admission and enrollment process.

Requirements
0-3 years of experience in Inside Sales, EdTech Sales, Admission Counseling, Telesales, or Business Development.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong convincing, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities.
Comfortable working with sales targets and performance metrics.
Ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable learning programs.
Good follow-up and relationship-management skills.
Candidates from EdTech, Education, BFSI, Telecom, or other sales-driven industries are preferred.
Willingness to work from the Pune office.
AboutCompany:
Started in 2015, upGrad is one of Asia's largest integrated Learning, Skilling, and Workforce Development Majors. It offers a range of online & hybrid skilling, pathway and study abroad courses, Certifications, and Bootcamps under its B2C portfolio. It also facilitates top Indian and global universities to offer their Diploma, Masters and Executive Doctorates. Additionally, select programs are tailored for Enterprise clients under the corporate skilling division, along with other recruitment and staffing services.
Origin: Co-founded by Ronnie Screwvala, Mayank Kumar, and Phalgun Kompall, upGrad was born to bridge the gap between imparting skills and employability, and is committed to providing affordable, accessible and high-quality lifelong learning at scale to millions worldwide. It caters to the end-to-end learning requirements of freshers to seasoned professionals in the age group of 18-60+ years who would use constant learning to enhance their skill sets while also receiving career acceleration.

Impact: To bridge the gap between academia and the industry, upGrad has built an immersive and 360-degree integrated learning solution that rests upon strong pillars like Content, Technology and Deep Personalization, further accelerating stronger career outcomes for learners. It enjoys a wide brands credibility and recall within India Inc. and globally, and continues to command strong course completion rates as high as 80%+ and higher Repeat and Referral rates annually. The skilling major has achieved two consecutive years of remarkable growth, closing FY23 and FY24 with over 55,000 successful career transitions, further establishing the credibility and mettle of the online higher education segment in India and globally.

Description:
Lead - Business Development
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.
Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, FTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
Role Description:
This is a full-time, on-site Product Promotion Manager role based in Chandigarh, with a field-based business development focus. As a key member of the BMA team, you will be responsible for driving the strategic expansion of Bharat Medtec Ascents innovative and patented product portfolio across Chandigarh and the adjoining northern region. This leadership-oriented role requires a seasoned professional who can navigate complex hospital procurement cycles, build high-level clinical partnerships, and execute effective market-entry strategies for new medical technologies. The role also involves engaging with hospitals and healthcare providers, gathering market and customer feedback, and sharing insights with product and leadership teams to refine product positioning and strategy. The Product Promotion Manager will track key performance metrics, prepare regular reports, and contribute to building scalable and repeatable business development frameworks for multiple Medtec products.

Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Market Expansion: Identify and penetrate untapped market segments within corporate hospital chains, government institutions, and private nursing homes across the assigned region.
Key Account Management: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), hospital administrators, and procurement heads.
Clinical Collaboration: Partner with surgical and medical teams to conduct product demonstrations, coordinate clinical training, and promote specialised devices through value-based selling.
Regulatory & Compliance: Ensure all business activities comply with applicable guidelines and international ethical standards for medical device marketing.
Tender Management: Lead the end-to-end institutional tender process, from technical specification development to commercial bid submission.

Required Qualifications & Skills:
Experience: Minimum 8-10 years of proven experience in medical device sales or business development. Experience in Neurology, Cardiology, Diagnostics, or other therapy areas is welcome.
Education: Bachelors degree in Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, or Pharmacy. An MBA in Marketing or Healthcare Management is highly desirable.
Regional Expertise: An established professional network within the Chandigarh healthcare ecosystem is highly desirable.
Technical Proficiency: Ability to discuss complex clinical outcomes and technical specifications with senior surgeons and specialists.
Analytical Prowess: Proficiency in market mapping, competitor analysis, and CRM-driven sales forecasting.
AboutCompany:
About Bharat Medtec Ascent (BMA)
Bharat MedTec Ascent (BMA), an initiative of HS Foundation India, is a product promotion platform dedicated to helping Indian MedTech startups successfully commercialise their innovations. We bridge the gap between product development and market adoption by enabling validated medical technologies to reach healthcare providers and patients across India.
Through a structured Product Promotion Program, BMA supports startups in building commercial readiness, strengthening clinician engagement, expanding sales and distribution networks, facilitating product adoption in both government and private hospitals, and enabling access to institutional procurement and tender opportunities. Backed by 40+ experienced product promotion professionals, clinical experts, and industry partners, we help innovators navigate the complexities of the healthcare market and accelerate sustainable growth.
Our mission is to enable indigenous MedTech innovations to scale faster, strengthen India's healthcare ecosystem, and contribute to a self-reliant future in medical technology.

Description:
Senior Manager Client Engagement Channel

Location

The position is open across the following locations:

New Delhi | Gurgaon | Faridabad | Chandigarh | Ludhiana | Mumbai | Pune | Bangalore | Kolkata | Jaipur | Ahmedabad | Chennai | Ranchi | Vadodra

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced and client-focused professional to join the Client Engagement Channel at HDFC Asset Management Company.

The role will be responsible for acquiring, managing and deepening relationships with High Net-worth Individuals (HNI), Ultra High Net-worth Individuals (UHNI) and Family Offices.

The incumbent will represent HDFC AMC's investment solutions across Mutual Funds (MF), Portfolio Management Services (PMS) and Alternative Investment Funds (AIF), with a strong focus on client experience, relationship management, business growth and compliant delivery.

Key Responsibilities

1. Client Acquisition & Portfolio Advisory

Build and manage relationships with HNI, UHNI and Family Office clients.
Introduce and position HDFC AMC's investment solutions across Mutual Funds, PMS and AIF based on client requirements.
Understand clients' investment objectives, financial goals and risk profiles to recommend suitable investment strategies.
Conduct periodic portfolio reviews and provide relevant investment solutions aligned with client needs.
Drive new client acquisition through targeted outreach, networking and referrals from existing clients.

2. Relationship Management & Business Growth
Develop strong, trusted and long-term relationships with high-value clients.
Drive client retention and enhance overall client satisfaction.
Identify opportunities to increase share of wallet through relevant cross-selling and upselling of HDFC AMC products.
Identify and develop new business opportunities through professional networks, client ecosystems and industry relationships.
Contribute towards sustainable growth of the client portfolio and business.

3. Client Engagement & Market Intelligence

Ensure a high level of client servicing through timely responses and personalized engagement.
Maintain consistent service standards and deliver a superior client experience.
Keep clients informed about relevant market trends, investment insights and developments.
Demonstrate strong product knowledge and provide a consultative, client-centric approach.
Build credibility and trust through effective communication and responsiveness.

4. Compliance & Governance

Ensure adherence to applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies and compliance frameworks.
Maintain accurate client documentation, records and reporting in accordance with company processes.
Ensure all client interactions and business activities are conducted in line with the required governance and compliance standards.

Key Skills & Competencies

Strong relationship-building and client management skills, particularly with HNI, UHNI and other high-value clients.
Good understanding of investment and wealth-management products, particularly Mutual Funds, PMS and AIF.
Strong client acquisition and business-development orientation.
Ability to identify cross-sell, upsell and wallet-share opportunities.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the confidence to interact with senior and sophisticated clients.
Consultative approach with a strong focus on client experience and service quality.
Strong market awareness and ability to understand and communicate relevant investment trends.
High level of ownership, professionalism and integrity.

Educational Qualification :

Any PG Qualification is essential


Ideal Candidate Profile :

The ideal candidate would have strong experience in wealth management, private banking, investment management or a similar client-facing financial-services environment, with exposure to HNI/UHNI clients and investment products such as MF, PMS and AIF.
Experience in client acquisition, relationship management, portfolio advisory, AUM/business growth and cross-selling would be highly relevant.

Description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
As an Interior Designer, you should have excellent creative thinking skills and be able to create modular designs based on conversations with a client. You should be confident communicating regularly with clients in order to assess their needs and be able to adjust a given approach based on feedback. You should maintain familiarity with the Interior Design landscape and trends in order to provide the best idea for the client.
Key Responsibilities:
To own the sales funnel and drive sales closure.
To own customer experience during a project.
To lead and own quality and accuracy of design deliverables.
To own an end-to-end project lifecycle.
EXPERTISE AND QUALIFICATIONS
B.Arch / B.Des from a design college.
Minimum experience of 2 years as an Interior Designer.
Led and delivered a minimum of 2 to 4 residential modular KWS projects.
Excellent knowledge of design tools, PPT presentation and AutoCAD.
Conceptual Design: Expertise in layout, style and mood boards.
Technical Design: Material knowledge, execution and drawing preparation.
Modular Design: Material knowledge, aesthetics and functionality, and module planning.
Civil Works & Services: Knowledge of specifications and installation details.
Project Expertise: Creating BoQs for customers and coordinating with internal and external agencies.

Job Summary

Delhivery is looking for an experienced operations leader to head Fulfillment Center (FC) Operations, drive operational excellence, improve productivity, optimize costs and ensure seamless end-to-end fulfillment. The role requires strong expertise in large-scale warehouse operations, supply chain management, inventory control, process improvement and team leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and oversee end-to-end fulfillment center operations, including inbound, receiving, put-away, storage, inventory management, picking, packing, dispatch and returns.
Develop and implement operational strategies to improve productivity, throughput, order accuracy, service quality and overall efficiency.
Drive operational excellence through process standardization, automation, technology adoption and continuous improvement initiatives.
Manage operational budgets, cost optimization, resource utilization and productivity targets to achieve business objectives.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including fulfillment accuracy, inventory accuracy, turnaround time, throughput, SLA adherence and cost per shipment.
Lead large operations teams, build leadership capability and drive a performance-oriented culture across fulfillment centers.
Drive capacity planning, manpower planning, infrastructure utilization and peak-season readiness in line with business volumes.
Collaborate with transportation, linehaul, first-mile, last-mile, technology, planning and customer experience teams to ensure seamless end-to-end operations.
Leverage warehouse management systems (WMS), data analytics and automation to improve operational visibility and decision-making.
Ensure adherence to operational SOPs, safety standards, statutory requirements and audit processes.
Identify operational bottlenecks, conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
Lead facility expansion, operational transformation and scalable process implementation to support business growth.


Required Qualifications and Experience

Proven experience managing large-scale fulfillment or warehouse operations, preferably across multiple facilities or locations.
Strong understanding of end-to-end warehouse processes, inventory management, order fulfillment and distribution operations.
Demonstrated success in improving operational KPIs, productivity, service levels and cost efficiency.
Experience in budget management, capacity planning, resource optimization and operational governance.
Proven ability to lead large teams and develop senior operational leaders.
Strong analytical, strategic planning, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.
Experience with warehouse management systems, operational dashboards and process improvement methodologies.

I hope you are doing well.
I am reaching out regarding an exciting opportunity with BD (Becton, Dickinson and Company) for the position of Deputy Manager Medical Affairs based in Chandigarh.
This role is ideal for a healthcare professional who enjoys engaging with clinicians, building KOL relationships, driving clinical education initiatives, and partnering closely with commercial teams to enhance healthcare outcomes.
About the Role
As a Deputy Manager Medical Affairs, you will play a key role in executing clinical strategies across the region by:
To execute and implement Clinical Strategies for MDS in the respective regions / territory in line with the market requirements and the country business plan with the purpose of creating clinically differentiated market position.
Principal Responsibilities
Conduct Clinical Marketing Education Programs, Seminars, Promotional Events and In-service Programs in the respective region in order to improve BD MDS value proposition amongst both clinical and economic buyers, by engaging KOLs towards MDS business outcome and achieve regional business objectives.
Clinical capability building (administering trainings, continuous evaluation) amongst regional MDS direct selling organization and amongst channel partners in line with the country clinical objectives in order to enhance their ability to adequately differentiate the brand MDS in the market and thus achieve targeted business outcomes.
Creating and implementing the regional calendar of engagements with the potential / existing customers in order to create strong brand awareness and creating door openers at the relevant levels.
Support / assist sales organization with product evaluations, clinical audits in hospitals, setting protocols and processes in hospitals and 'critical to business' technical challenges (including but not limited to troubleshooting and product applications) in order to attain high levels of product penetration, query resolution and trouble free product application.
Leading edge key customer relationship management and creation of regional KOL network in order to ensure usage of full array of BD MDS products by leading client organizations and using these customer relationships to drive the conversions.
Coordinate on the timely completion of clinical /economic studies initiated in the region in order to ensure that the clinical / economic studies planned for the year are completed within the stipulated timelines.
Conduct Induction Training Programs (Clinical & Product Training) to Sales Organization, provide clinical Updates, annual / quarterly Product refreshers and run Clinical Proficiency Tests on a need basis / from time to time.
Preferred Background
We are particularly interested in professionals with:
MBBS qualification (MBA preferred)
3-5 years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
Medical Affairs
Clinical Affairs
Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL)
Clinical Education
Scientific Affairs
Clinical Applications / Clinical Specialist roles
Strong experience in:
KOL development and physician engagement
CME/CNE programs
Clinical training and education
Hospital stakeholder management
Product demonstrations and evaluations
Cross-functional collaboration with commercial/sales teams
Exposure to:
Medical Devices
Diagnostics
MedTech
Pharma
Critical Care
Infusion Therapy
Infection Prevention
Vascular Access
Willingness to travel extensively (70-80%) across North India.
Why Consider BD?
BD is a global leader in medical technology, advancing the world of health by improving medical discovery, diagnostics, and the delivery of care. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with leading hospitals, clinicians, and healthcare decision-makers while contributing to meaningful patient outcomes.
If this opportunity aligns with your experience and career aspirations, I would be happy to connect and share further details.
Please feel free to reply with your updated resume and a suitable time to speak.
Looking forward to hearing from you.
AboutCompany: BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world and is advancing the world of healthTM by improving medical discovery, diagnostics and the delivery of care. The company supports the heroes on the frontlines of healthcare by developing innovative technology, services and solutions that help advance both clinical therapy for patients and clinical process for healthcare providers. BD and its 75,000 employees have a passion and commitment to help enhance the safety and efficiency of clinicians' care delivery process, enable laboratory scientists to accurately detect disease and advance researchers' capabilities to develop the next generation of diagnostics and therapeutics. BD has a presence in virtually every country and partners with organizations around the world to address some of the most challenging global health issues. By working in close collaboration with customers, BD can help enhance outcomes, lower costs, increase efficiencies, improve safety and expand access to healthcare.

FinX focuses on employability and employment for students, its subsidiary CIEL (Centre for Investment Education & Learning) focuses on corporate trainings, upskilling and Financial Awareness.
Role Overview: As the Area Manager - Business Development you will drive strategic partnerships with Universities, Colleges, MBA Institutes, Other educational institutions for BFSI focused vocational courses in your location. You will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth, expanding business opportunities, and shaping the company's business growth. You will focus on securing key business mandates and building deep relationships with Vice Chancellors, Directors, Principals & HODs. This role requires a strong business acumen, relationship building experience, and the ability to work collaboratively across teams to achieve ambitious growth targets.
Key Responsibilities:
Relationship Building with Education Institutions: Establish and nurture strategic partnerships with Educational Institutions for our Industry focused vocational courses for their students with improved learning & placement outcomes.

Joint Management/PG/UG Programs: Lead efforts to secure mandates for customized BFSI Industry focused Joint programs wherein curriculum design, delivery, placement shall be our primary responsibility e.g. PGDBM (Financial Services), BCom (Capital Markets), PGDM( Banking, Lending & Credit)

Certifications: Drive alliances & initiatives to drive FinX Job- Readiness Certifications on BFSI, Wealth Management, Stock Markets, Equity, Debt, Lending, Alternate Assets etc. These certifications also have sales & behavioral skills embedded for a 360 degree perspective of knowledge & application

Short Courses: Embedding BFSI focused specialized trainer led short courses and NISM Certifications along with regular academic curriculum of UG/PG/ Management to improve knowledge level & employability profile of students e.g. Mutual Funds, Research Analyst, Equity Derivatives, Investment Banking, Financial Markets, Portfolio Management Services

Revenue Growth: Own and drive revenue growth, identifying new business opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, and building a pipeline of potential clients.

Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams (product, marketing, operations) to ensure smooth delivery of solutions that meet client needs.

Client Relationship Management: Build long-term relationships with clients, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and repeat business.


Market Insights: Stay updated on market trends, competition, and opportunities, using insights to shape business development strategies.

Description:
Exhibits culinary talents by personally performing tasks while assisting in leading the staff and managing all food related functions.
Works to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction while maximizing the ficial performance in all areas of responsibility.
Assists in supervising all kitchen areas to ensure a consistent, high quality product is produced.
Responsible for guiding and developing staff including direct reports.
Must ensure sanitation and food standards are achieved.
Areas of responsibility comprise overseeing all food preparation areas (eg, banquets, room service, restaurants, bar/lounge and employee cafeteria) and all support areas (eg, dish room and purchasing) as applicable.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Culinary Arts, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the culinary, food and beverage, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Assisting in Leading Kitchen Operations for Property
- Provides direction for all day-to-day operations.
- Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence or determine appropriate replacement to fill gaps.
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Supervises and coordinates activities of cooks and workers engaged in food preparation.
- Demonstrate new cooking techniques and equipment to staff.
Setting and Maintaining Goals for Culinary Function and Activities
- Develops and implements guidelines and control procedures for purchasing and receiving areas.
- Establishes goals including performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc
- Communicates the importance of safety procedures, detailing procedure codes, ensuring employee understanding of safety codes, monitoring processes and procedures related to safety.
- Manages department controllable expenses including food cost, supplies, uniforms and equipment.
- Participates in the budgeting process for areas of responsibility.
- Knows and implements the brands safety standards.
Ensuring Culinary Standards and Responsibilities are Met
- Provides direction for menu development.
- Monitors the quality of raw and cooked food products to ensure that standards are met.
- Determines how food should be presented, and create decorative food displays.
- Recognizes superior quality products, presentations and flavor.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Follows proper handling and right temperature of all food products.
- Ensures employees maintain required food handling and sanitation certifications.
- Maintains purchasing, receiving and food storage standards.
- Prepares and cooks foods of all types, either on a regular basis or for special guests or functions.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides and supports service behaviors that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
- Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.
- Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
- Trains kitchen associates on the fundamentals of good cooking and excellent plate presentations.
- Administers the performance appraisal process for direct report managers.
- Interacts with the Banquet Chef and Catering department on training regarding food knowledge and menu composition.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and or managers.
- Manages employee progressive discipline procedures for areas of responsibility.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 23,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands. Job Description:
The Client Service at Delhivery will be responsible to provide exceptional service and support to customers, ensuring their satisfaction with Delhivery's products and services. You will handle inquiries, complaints, and requests through various communication channels, including phone, email, and chat. Your role involves understanding customer needs, resolving issues, and delivering accurate and timely information.
Key Responsibilities: 

Providing assistance with shipment tracking and delivery inquiries and drive regular engagement/quick response 
Resolving issues related to shipments (missing or damaged packages, customs delays, or delivery exceptions) 
CS Engagement via Ticketing module, getting timely response; Keep active track of timely closure of tickets 
Assisting with billing inquiries such as explaining charges, resolving disputes and/or claims, or providing information on payment options 
Providing support for shipping services and delivery options available, regulatory compliance, documentation requirements, claim monitoring 
Analyze and support with insights to improve the process and internal operations and service levels 
Handling customer escalations-preparing RCA / CAPA and providing the solution 
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maintain and increase performance of client accounts 
Designing SOP, mapping and freezing requirements, client NPS management and providing best solutions to the business
AboutCompany: Delhivery Limited is India's largest and fastest-growing fully-integrated logistics services player by revenue as of Fiscal 2021. With its nationwide network covering over 17,000 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services. Delhivery has successfully fulfilled over 1 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 23,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands. For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced SAP CAR Consultant with expertise in SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR), CAR Planning, and UDF (Unified Demand Forecast) solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in retail business processes, demand forecasting, replenishment planning, inventory optimization, and SAP CAR implementations/support projects.
Key Responsibilities
SAP CAR Implementation & Support
Participate in end-to-end SAP CAR implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into SAP CAR functional solutions.
Configure and support SAP CAR modules including:
POSDTA (Point of Sale Data Transfer & Audit)
OAA (Omnichannel Article Availability)
DDF (Demand Data Foundation)
UDF (Unified Demand Forecast)
CAR Planning & Forecasting
Forecasting & Replenishment
Design and configure forecasting models using SAP UDF.
Support demand planning, inventory planning, and replenishment optimization processes.
Analyze sales trends, seasonality, promotions, and forecast accuracy.
Develop forecast strategies to improve inventory availability and reduce stock-outs.
Integration
Integrate SAP CAR with:
SAP S/4HANA / ECC
SAP Retail
SAP BW/4HANA
SAP F&R
SAP IBP (preferred)
POS systems and third-party applications
Support master data and transactional data integration.
Business & Functional Activities
Conduct workshops, fit-gap analysis, and solution design sessions.
Prepare functional specifications and work with technical teams for developments.
Perform SIT, UAT, and production deployment activities.
Provide post-go-live support and issue resolution.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business users, architects, and development teams.
Provide recommendations for process optimization and system enhancements.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions.
Required Skills
Functional Skills
Strong experience in SAP CAR.
Hands-on experience with:
SAP UDF (Unified Demand Forecast)
CAR Planning
Demand Forecasting
Replenishment Planning
Inventory Optimization
Retail Processes
Understanding of merchandise planning and supply chain processes.
Technical Knowledge
Knowledge of SAP HANA.
Experience with data modeling and data extraction.
Understanding of IDocs, APIs, SLT, and integration frameworks.
Basic ABAP debugging knowledge preferred.
Domain Expertise
Retail industry experience is highly preferred.
Understanding of:
Merchandise Management
Supply Chain Planning
Inventory Management
Omnichannel Retail Operations
Mandatory Qualifications
6-15 years of SAP experience.
Minimum 4+ years of SAP CAR experience.
At least one end-to-end SAP CAR implementation project.
Experience in UDF configuration and forecasting processes.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

Job Description
Job Title: Product Lifecycle Risk Manager, AVP
Location: Mumbai, India
Alternative Locations: Pune, India / Bangalore, India


Role Description:
Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.

About DWS Investment Risk:
The Chief Risk Office within DWS is an independent function responsible for protecting the business as well as being a trusted adviser and partner for supporting sustainable business growth.
As part of the Chief Risk Office, Investment Risk provides independent oversight and challenge of risks arising from DWS fiduciary activities, including the governance of investment products throughout their lifecycle.
The Product Life Cycle Risk Team is responsible for the New Product Approval framework, related policies, procedures, controls and governance tooling. The team works closely with Business, Investment, Product Management and control functions to support robust, transparent and regulatory-compliant product decisions.

What we’ll offer you
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
Best in class leave policy
Gender neutral parental leaves
100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities
Manage and further develop Product Risk processes, policies, controls and governance frameworks across the product lifecycle, ensuring consistent, scalable and effective standards.
Manage and continuously enhance the New Product Approval (NPA) framework, including transparent prioritization of initiatives and effective management of dependencies across the product pipeline.
Perform independent 2LoD reviews of NPA submissions and support the relevant Risk Type Heads in assessing and signing off product initiatives, including the identification, challenge and escalation of material risks and control gaps.
Own and further develop the NPA platform and related governance tooling, driving system enhancements, process automation and scalable workflow solutions.
Coordinate Product Governance activities across Business, Investment, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations and other control functions to ensure initiatives are complete, decision-ready and progressed effectively through the governance process.
Support governance committees and contribute to global Product Lifecycle initiatives through management information, decision materials, governance records, regulatory implementation and process transformation.

Your skills and experience
University degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience, with at least five years of relevant experience in Asset Management, Product Governance, Product Management, Risk Management, Compliance, Operations, Regulatory Change or a related governance or control function.
Strong understanding of investment products, asset management operating models, product lifecycle management and Product Governance frameworks within a regulated financial services environment.
Knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements, with the ability to assess regulatory developments and translate their impact into appropriate governance processes, policies and controls.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to independently review and challenge complex product initiatives, identify material risks and control gaps, and formulate clear, practical recommendations.
Experience managing or enhancing governance processes, workflows and control frameworks, including translating governance requirements into system enhancements and supporting tool implementation, testing, migration or automation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organizational skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior stakeholders and committees, constructively influence cross-functional teams and deliver high-quality outcomes across competing priorities.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with data analytics, reporting tools or process automation solutions is advantageous.

How we’ll support you
Training and development to help you excel in your career
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

About the Role
Capgemini is seeking highly skilled SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultants to join our growing SAP Finance Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Central Finance, SAP S/4HANA Finance, financial process transformation, data migration, and system integration. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-wide Central Finance solutions for global clients.
Key Responsibilities
SAP Central Finance Implementation & Solution Design
Lead and participate in end-to-end SAP Central Finance (CFIN) implementation projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP Central Finance solutions.
Configure and support SAP CFIN functionalities including:
Initial Load & Replication
Central Payment
Central Reconciliation
Application Interface Framework (AIF)
Source System Mapping
Key & Value Mapping
Design and implement real-time financial data replication using SAP LT Replication Server (SLT).
Collaborate with business teams to harmonize finance processes across multiple ERP landscapes.
Integration & Data Migration
Integrate SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems into the SAP Central Finance environment.
Manage data migration activities, including data cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
Support financial master data governance and integration with SAP MDG.
Ensure data consistency, completeness, and accuracy throughout migration and replication processes.
Troubleshoot replication and interface issues to ensure business continuity.
Finance Transformation & Process Optimization
Drive finance transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA Central Finance capabilities.
Analyze existing business processes and recommend improvements based on SAP best practices.
Enable process standardization and harmonization across global business units.
Support business stakeholders in defining future-state finance operating models.
Financial Reporting & Support
Support financial reporting, analytics, and consolidation requirements.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions using SAP Fiori, Embedded Analytics, SAC, and BW.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Provide post-go-live support and resolve issues related to:
Data Replication
Financial Postings
AIF Monitoring
Mapping Errors
Reconciliation Discrepancies
Financial Reporting
Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP Central Finance (CFIN).
Expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP FI/CO.
Experience with:
SLT Replication
AIF Framework
MDG Integration
Data Migration & Reconciliation
Financial Master Data Management
SAP Fiori Applications
Understanding of SAP integration methodologies and architecture.
Functional Expertise
Strong knowledge of:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Bank Accounting
Financial Closing & Reporting
Preferred Experience
6 to 15 years of SAP consulting experience.
Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SAP Central Finance experience.
At least one full lifecycle SAP Central Finance implementation is preferred.
Experience working on global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
Exposure to Treasury, Group Reporting, and Cash Management would be an advantage.
Experience in Agile and SAP Activate methodologies.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
SAP controls design, integration and assurance
Lead pre- and post-implementation control design assessments, fit-gap reviews, configuration testing, and operating effectiveness support across R2R, O2C, P2P, P2M and related cross-functional processes.
Oversee development and review of control activity narratives (CANs), manual control procedures (MCPs), control test scripts (CTSs), risk and control matrices (RCMs), process flows and control ownership/RACI documentation.
Assess automated application controls, configurable controls, interfaces, key reports, data dependencies, exception handling, and manual controls reliant on SAP-generated information.
Challenge design deviations, identify control gaps, evaluate business and financial reporting impact, and recommend remediation or compensating controls with clear ownership and deadlines.
Oversee RICEFW/WRICEF reviews, functional specifications, custom enhancements, defect and change assessments, testing evidence, and control impacts throughout project releases and hypercare.
Technology risk, security and regulatory compliance
Direct SAP ITGC reviews covering user access, privileged access, authentication, change management, operations, logging, and configuration governance, aligned to relevant SOX and audit requirements.
Guide SAP GRC and Pathlock-related reviews, including access request approvals, periodic access reviews, segregation of duties (SoD), sensitive access, ruleset governance and mitigating controls.
Provide implementation assurance through design checkpoints, go-live readiness reviews, risk escalation, remediation validation, and coordination with internal and external assurance teams.
Engagement and people leadership
Own engagement planning, budgets, resourcing, work allocation, milestones, quality review, issue resolution and senior stakeholder reporting across concurrent projects.
Coach and review multidisciplinary teams; set clear expectations for documentation, evidence sufficiency, technical accuracy, productivity, and timely delivery.
Build trusted relationships with overseas engagement teams, client process owners, SAP functional and technical leads, compliance teams, and program management offices.
Contribute to proposals, solution development, methodology improvement, knowledge assets, reusable testing accelerators and practice growth.

Description:
Designation : Business Analyst
Location : Bangalore & Navi Mumbai Location

Responsibilities :
Business Analyst would be responsible for working closely with the Business Teams and helping them in making data driven decisions. This would require cross-communication between the Business Team, Product Team & Data Engineering as well. Apart from solving the business problem at hand, a Business Analyst would also be responsible for sharing insights and learning basis the data exploration/mining and convert these into clear action points and ensure that the same are being worked upon
Getting business requirements from the respective Business Teams, identifying the
underlying business case and building a generalized solution
Extracting & Exploring the data from database and other sources that may exist,
cleaning the data for any issues/missing values also needs to be owned upon
Converting the cleaned data into actionable insights and sharing the same with relevant
Audience
Automation of data problems/solutions that occur recursively
Flagging to Data Engineering in case of data sanity issues are to be seen
Ensure that the action insights shared with the business teams are worked upon
Ensure new business requirements are thoroughly vetted and signed off
Knowledge sharing within the team and outside if required

What are we looking for ?
2 to 4 years of work experience in the relevant field, preferably in a consumer facing company
Proficient in SQL and/or HQL , ability to handle complex/inner queries
Hands-on with Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel (basic data cleaning, pivoting and data exploration)
Must have worked on any one Data Visualization Tool (Tableau, Power BI, Microstrategy, Metabase etc)
Basic automation skills using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel are expected
Hands on Knowledge of Python programming and Python for Data Analytics
Working knowledge on Machine Learning and Data Science Algorithms are a plus
Communication skills to get the business requirements and give out the final insights
Data Inquisitiveness

Description:
Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) Azure, Kubernetes & Terraform
Experience: 48 years
Role Overview
We are seeking experienced and hands-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost-awareness, and delivery quality.
Key Responsibilities
Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
Architect and operate production-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform module design, remote state, workspaces, policy-as-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
Build, maintain, and optimize end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
Develop Python-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day-2 operations across cloud platforms.
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy-as-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.
Required Skills and Experience
Strong hands-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps);
Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi-environment patterns, and integration with policy-as-code frameworks.
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply-chain controls.
Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
Qualification and Certifications
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 / AZ-305 / AZ-400), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security+).
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.

Locations- Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Kolkata, Noida, Kochi, Coimbatore
