Description:
About the Role
Were building and growing our hyperlocal (on-demand) logistics business within Delhivery, and are for someone who can take ownership from day zero acquiring customers, shaping the GTM motion, and building a repeatable revenue engine.
You will operate as a full-stack sales owner — from identifying opportunities within SMEs and enterprises to closing deals and ensuring long-term account success. The role requires a mix of hunting (acquisition) and farming (growth & retention), with a strong bias toward building from scratch.

What You’ll Do
Own the end-to-end sales cycle: prospecting pitching closing account growth for leads with monthly wallet potential of 5L to 10L
Acquire and onboard SMEs and enterprise customers onto Delhivery’s hyperlocal logistics platform
Build a strong pipeline through outbound efforts, partnerships, and market mapping
Work closely with operations to ensure a seamless fulfillment experience for customers while providing top-notch customer assistance
Drive account expansion and retention, identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities
Develop a deep understanding of customer supply chains and last-mile needs
Contribute to GTM strategy, pricing inputs, and product feedback as an early member of the business
Lay the foundation for scaling this business line and becoming a trusted + reliable logistics partner for our customers
Who We’re Looking For
2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, with a strong focus on acquisition-led roles
Prior experience in logistics, on-demand delivery, or supply chain platforms
Strong exposure to both SME and enterprise sales
Hands-on experience with solution selling (not just transactional sales)
High ownership mindset — comfortable operating in 0-1 environments
Strong understanding of last-mile logistics, fulfillment challenges, and operational nuances

What Makes This Role Different
You’re not inheriting a book of business — you’re building it
Direct impact on shaping a new vertical within Delhivery
Opportunity to scale into a larger role as the business grows
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Job Description Inside Sales Executive
Company: NoBroker.com
Department: Sales – Supply RM
Location: Bangalore
Work Mode: Work From Office (WFO)
Languages Required: English, Hindi, and a Regional Language
Role Overview
We are looking for a motivated and customer-focused Inside Sales Executive to manage customers who have already enrolled in a plan through the Supply RM team. The role involves understanding customer property requirements, recommending suitable properties, managing follow-ups, conducting negotiations, and driving property visits and deal closures while ensuring an excellent customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Connect with customers who have enrolled in a plan through the Supply RM team.
Understand customer requirements, including location, budget, property type, preferences, and timelines.
Build and maintain strong customer relationships throughout the property search journey.
Recommend suitable properties based on customer needs and preferences.
Explain property details, features, pricing, and other relevant information.
Address customer queries, concerns, and objections effectively.
Conduct regular follow-ups to maintain customer engagement and drive conversions.
Coordinate with internal teams to identify and provide suitable property options.
Encourage customers to schedule property visits and progress toward transactions.
Negotiate effectively to convert sales opportunities into successful property deals.
Take ownership of the customer journey from lead allocation to deal closure.
Maintain accurate customer, lead, follow-up, and sales records in the CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales and conversion targets.
Ensure a positive customer experience throughout the sales process.
Requirements & Qualifications
Any Graduate or Postgraduate preferred.
Experience in Inside Sales, Real Estate Sales, Property Sales, B2C Sales, or Telesales is preferred.
Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong customer relationship management and customer-handling abilities.
Ability to understand customer needs and recommend appropriate property options.
Good negotiation, persuasion, objection-handling, and sales-closing skills.
Comfortable working in a target-driven sales environment.
Strong follow-up, lead-management, and organizational skills.
Familiarity with CRM systems and sales processes.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Conversion rate from enrolled leads to property visits.
Number of successful property deal closures.
Achievement of daily and monthly sales targets.
Customer follow-up effectiveness and lead conversion rate.
Customer satisfaction and overall sales performance.
Preferred Skills
Customer relationship management
Consultative selling
Real estate market and property knowledge
Lead nurturing and follow-up
Negotiation and objection handling
CRM management
Target achievement and sales conversion

Job Description: AEO / SEO / GEO Specialist, Trivitron Digital.ai

Location: Chennai / Mumbai / Bangalore (Onsite only)

Type: Full-time

Experience: 4-8 years

Reports to: Head of Growth / Digital Transformation

About Trivitron Digital.ai (TDAI):
Trivitron Digital.ai is an AI-powered health technology platform. It is a joint venture between Trivitron Healthcare and
ResoHealth. Our products include LIS, RIS, HIS, CRM, LIMS, Claims IQ, peri-operative AI and an AI Health Companion.
Hospitals, diagnostic labs and wellness providers across India, the GCC and emerging markets use them.

The Role:
People now look for information in two places: traditional search engines and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini,
Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. We want TDAI and our customers to be the trusted answer in both. In this role youll
own organic visibility for TDAIs brand and products. Youll also help our hospital, diagnostics and wellness customers grow
their own search and AI visibility.

Key Responsibilities:

1. SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
Own technical, on-page and off-page SEO for TDAI’s websites and product pages
Do keyword research for B2B healthtech terms (e.g., “LIS software India”, “hospital management system UAE”)
and for patient-facing searches made to our customers
Build high-quality backlinks from healthcare, health IT and industry publications in India and the GCC
Run local SEO (Google Business Profile, directories, citations) for multi-location hospital and diagnostic chains
2. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
Structure content so it gets picked up for featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice search and AI Overviews
Implement schema markup (MedicalOrganization, Hospital, MedicalTest, FAQ, Product, Organization)
Build FAQ and Q&A content hubs that answer real buyer and patient questions
3. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
Track and improve how TDAI and our customers are cited in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Claude
Build entity authority through Wikipedia/Wikidata, knowledge panels, authoritative mentions, PR and citationworthy
content (research, benchmarks, reports)
Set up prompt-level tracking for brand share-of-voice in AI answers and report on it
4. Customer Growth Services
Audit and improve search and AI visibility for hospital, diagnostics and wellness clients
Create playbooks for doctor profiles, test/package pages, location pages and review management
Connect visibility to business outcomes: appointments, test bookings, leads and footfall
5. Content, Compliance and Collaboration
Work with content, product, clinical and sales teams on content that is accurate and meets E-E-A-T standards
Follow healthcare content norms: medical review, no misleading claims, and data privacy (DPDP Act, UAE regulations)
Track and report on rankings, organic traffic, AI citations, DA/DR, leads and conversions

What You Bring:
4–8 years in SEO, with hands-on exposure to AEO/GEO or AI search visibility
Experience in healthcare, healthtech, diagnostics, hospitals or B2B SaaS (strongly preferred)
Strong command of Ahrefs/SEMrush, Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog and schema tools
Familiarity with AI visibility tools (e.g., Profound, Otterly, Peec AI, or your own tracking methods)
Working knowledge of HTML, structured data, site architecture and CMS platforms (WordPress, headless CMS)
Excellent written English; regional languages or Arabic are a plus
A proven track record of moving rankings, traffic and leads, with case studies to show

KPIs:
Organic traffic and qualified leads from search
Rankings for priority keywords (India and GCC)
Brand mentions and citations in AI answer engines
Featured snippets and AI Overview inclusions
DA/DR and growth in high-quality backlinks
Measurable visibility gains for customer accounts

Description:
Senior NETWORK ENGINEER
Experience: 5 to 12 Years
Role Summary: Provide senior technical leadership, oversee L1/L2 operations, manage complex incidents and escalations, and drive SLA compliance and service improvement.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead day-to-day L1/L2 network operations.
Ensure incident response, mitigation and resolution meet SLA targets.
Take technical ownership of major and complex incidents.
Lead advanced troubleshooting across routing, switching, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, firewalls, VPN and load balancing.
Review complex configuration changes and implementation plans.
Drive RCA and permanent corrective actions.
Analyze network trends, recurring faults, capacity and performance issues.
Identify opportunities for optimization and continuous improvement.
Coordinate with L3 teams for highly complex issues.
Coordinate with OEMs, ISPs, telecom providers and other vendors.
Oversee upgrade and patching activities within scope.
Review ticket quality and escalation quality.
Ensure compliance with SOPs, runbooks and change processes.
Mentor U2 and U3 engineers.
Participate in monthly and quarterly service reviews.
Track SLA performance, KPIs, risks and mitigation plans.
Support transition, knowledge transfer and service stabilization.

Required Skills:
Strong enterprise routing and switching expertise
Advanced Layer 2/Layer 3 troubleshooting
WAN, MPLS, VPN and SD-WAN
Enterprise firewall and security policy concepts
Cisco wireless
F5/load-balancing knowledge
QoS, traffic analysis and performance optimization
Major incident management and RCA
ITIL Incident, Problem and Change Management
Network monitoring, reporting and ITSM tools

Preferred: CCNP Enterprise/CCNP Security, SD-WAN expertise, firewall certification, F5 exposure, ITIL Foundation
